title: User Report Contract
description: Standard schema for student crowdsourced reports (elevator out, ramp blocked, path icy/closed) sent from the UI to MongoDB.

lat.description: Report latitude (from device GPS or clicked map pin)

lng.description: Report longitude (from device GPS or clicked map pin)

title.description: Short headline (e.g. 'ILC West Elevator Beeping & Stalled')

description.description: Free text report parsed by Gemini in background into structured outage

connector_id.description: Optional. Graph connector this report is about (e.g. 'cc-concourse-elevator'). Lets the router close exactly that elevator instead of everything within radius. Backend should store and echo it on the resulting closure.
